name: sanity-check
title_zh: 视频生成前先查四类硬伤的质检员
tagline_zh: 生成提示词前，先让 AI 看证据图和种子图，专抓动作穿帮、解剖错位、物理离谱、剧情断链——修完再进视频环节。
tagline_en: Before prompting video, it inspects source evidence & seeds, flags action-read, anatomy, physics, continuity.
desc_en: Route CopyCat seed visual review to Antigravity before video prompting, so it can inspect source evidence and seeds, write the sanity report, and catch action-read, anatomy, physics, and continuity errors. Use after seed generation or repair; Codex fixes the reported seeds and prompts.
why_zh: 把「先审后产」焊进流程：质检发生在视频提示词之前，基于源证据而非事后脑补，错误定位到具体种子，修复闭环。
why_en: Review gates generation: checks happen pre-prompt against source evidence, not post-hoc vibes. Errors trace to specific seeds.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 CopyCat 种子视觉审查，需已有种子图和源证据；不修代码逻辑、不审音频，超出四类错误范围它不会主动扩检。
limit_en: Only for CopyCat seed visual review with existing seeds & evidence. No code/audio checks; won't expand beyond the four error classes on its own.
title_en: Pre-video sanity checker for four error types
